name: kestrel-analytics
description: Lightweight realtime web analytics on Tencent EdgeOne

scripts.dev:all: npm run seed:mock && npx concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "node scripts/mock-api.mjs" "npm run dev -w @kestrel/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kestrel/shared && npm run build -w @kestrel/tracking-script && npm run build -w @kestrel/frontend
scripts.test:ci: npm run build -w @kestrel/shared && npm run build:tracker && npm run typecheck && npm test
